The value comes from the masked `shared` Fidelius entry, so I can’t correct the underlying connection string from this repo. I also found that the startup error and `doctor` script print credentials; I’m removing those disclosures while keeping the validation clear.

item.text:
`npm start` fails because the `shared` Fidelius `DATABASE_URL` has a scheme the app does not accept. I changed [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.Au6jSU/shop-api/src/server.js) and [doctor.sh](/private/tmp/envtest.Au6jSU/shop-api/scripts/doctor.sh) to report the required scheme without printing credentials.

The code starts with a sample PostgreSQL URL, but `npm start` still fails with the stored value. To finish the fix, set `shared` → `DATABASE_URL` in Fidelius to your real connection URL beginning with `postgres://` or `postgresql://`, then run `npm start` again.
